scope: Focused C5 exception-restart and initial-output fixes, CLI/WASM/worker registration, SRAM image framing, explicit boot mode and capability boundaries. Fixed commit archive used for source and isolated five-crate tests. No production files modified.

paddedApp.recipe: Append 0xff to the unmodified 560-byte probe.bin until the file is exactly 4 MiB.

faultApp.recipe: Replace first SRAM instruction at file offset 32 with actual opcode 0x00002283 (lw t0,0(zero)); recompute XOR byte 527 and appended SHA-256 bytes 528..560.

findings.title: Oversized valid C5 application panics at CLI staging write
findings.trigger: esp32sim --chip c5 --boot app --app <probe padded to 4 MiB> --max-insns 1

before.panic: called Result::unwrap() on Err: C5 app staging exceeds configured flash capacity

after.message: C5 app staging exceeds configured flash capacity

findings.impact: CLI application-file boundary only; WASM returns an error and JS rejects FLASH_OVERFLOW.

machine.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated-target> cargo +stable test -p esp32c5 --test machine -- --nocapture
machine.exceptionRecovery: Actual lw-at-zero causes Exceptions(1); reboot restores staged app, READY and UART IRQ/LED. A second actual fault causes Exceptions(2); boot_app restores READY/IRQ. Totals remain cumulative; ceilings renew to 2/3.
machine.initialOutput: Both Stamp-C5 boards start with actual off LEDs and generation 1; READY keeps 1, UART0 byte '1' gives blue at 2, byte '0' gives off at 3, wrong-pin 'W' keeps 3.

wasmAbi.loaderErrors: Truncated header, wrong chip, bad XOR, unknown kind 999, valid oversized app and load_at 0xffffffff all return error without a WASM trap.
wasmAbi.rom: Boot returns error before and after app loading; actual official ROM ELF load also returns a bounded SRAM-range error. No ROM execution attempted.
wasmAbi.initialOutput: Each board emits real UART READY and ring [[0,0,0]] after the normal web-push deadline.
wasmAbi.faultRecovery: Each board executes 2 rounds of actual lw-at-zero fault (run stop 4), reloads original app and emits fresh READY, then UART0 bytes '1'/'0' yield blue/off rings.
wasmAbi.cleanup: Each emulator deleted in finally; ABI allocations freed. JIT compilation throws if unexpectedly invoked; none occurred.

cli.positive: Both boards execute real READY using the default app-direct mode; exit 0.
cli.exceptionCeiling: Actual fault image stops at Exceptions(1), with 1 dispatched instruction, read fault 0 and no fabricated READY; generic prepare preserves the C5 default ceiling.

javascript.scope: C5 framing/ranges/entry/revision/integrity, both SKU loadkind3/app-direct reset, remote explicit mode, manifest restrictions and disabled ROM/storage/audio/network; ordinary local build/merged-image validation for S3/C6/P4. Worker doubles used in C5 protocol tests are not execution evidence.

checks.sourceReview: Ordinary Socs retain EXCEPTION_BUDGET_AFTER_RESET=None; added branches in runtime, worker, memory configuration and capabilities are C5-only. Source identifies limited SRAM execution and does not claim stock ROM/IDF, RF, audio, SD, OTA, persistent Flash or physical UART timing.

conclusion: No remaining P0/P1/P2 found within this focused scope after ac8951c4. The CLI P2 and its failing input are retained.
limits: Not a whole-task acceptance or full CI review.
No browser run in this review; public UI flow is covered by separate receipts.
Did not repeat previous register audit, ROM boundary run or randomized parser stress.
Native cold reset and explicit boot_app tested; WASM explicit app restart tested. Platform worker lifecycle receipt was inspected separately, not rerun here.
Ordinary-chip conditional source review and local-image parser tests do not establish full ordinary-chip execution compatibility.
privacy: Curated facts only; no home-directory names, host identity, process inventory, agent-session narrative, raw event arrays or unrelated logs included. Temporary paths identify reproducibility artifacts.
